name: HTML Element
description: A custom HTML element placed on top of the canvas that can display arbitrary HTML content.

conditions.description: Triggered when any part of the element is clicked.
Triggered when an element with a specific ID is clicked.

id.name: ID
id.desc: The ID of the element that was clicked.

conditions.description: Triggered when an element with a specific class is clicked.

class.name: Class
class.desc: The class of the element that was clicked. Use space-separated class names to match multiple classes.

conditions.description: Triggered when a CSS animation ends.

animation-name.name: Animation name
animation-name.desc: The name of the CSS animation (as defined by the @keyframes rule), case insensitive.

actions.description: Set the content of the element to a string of HTML, BBcode or plain text. NOTE: escape user-provided values in HTML.

content-type.name: Content type
content-type.desc: How to interpret the given string.

string.name: String
string.desc: A string to set for the element content. NOTE: escape user-provided values in HTML.

selector.name: Selector
selector.desc: An optional CSS selector of a child element to set the content for. Leave empty to set content for the entire element.

type.name: Type
type.desc: Whether to affect one element matching the selector, or all matching elements.

actions.description: Insert a string of HTML, BBcode or plain text. NOTE: escape user-provided values in HTML.

content-type.name: Content type
content-type.desc: How to interpret the given string.

string.name: String
string.desc: A string to set for the element content. NOTE: escape user-provided values in HTML.

position.name: Position
position.desc: Whether to insert content at the start or end of the element.

selector.name: Selector
selector.desc: An optional CSS selector of a child element to insert content to. Leave empty to insert content to the main HTML element.

type.name: Type
type.desc: Whether to affect one element matching the selector, or all matching elements.

actions.description: Remove or clear elements matching a CSS selector.

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc: Whether to entirely remove the matching elements, or clear their contents.

selector.name: Selector
selector.desc: A CSS selector which will be used to match elements. Leave empty to clear the main HTML element.

type.name: Type
type.desc: Whether to affect one element matching the selector, or all matching elements.

actions.description: Add, toggle or remove classes for elements matching a CSS selector.

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc: Whether to add, toggle or remove classes.

class.name: Class
class.desc: The class name to change. Use space-separated class names to affect multiple classes.

selector.name: Selector
selector.desc: A CSS selector which will be used to match elements. Leave empty to use the main HTML element.

type.name: Type
type.desc: Whether to affect one element matching the selector, or all matching elements.

actions.description: Set or remove attributes for elements matching a CSS selector.

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc: Whether to set or remove attributes.

value.name: Value
value.desc: The value to set for the attribute (ignored if removing attribute).

selector.name: Selector
selector.desc: A CSS selector which will be used to match elements. Leave empty to use the main HTML element.

type.name: Type
type.desc: Whether to affect one element matching the selector, or all matching elements.

actions.description: Set a CSS style on elements matching a CSS selector.

property-name.name: Property name
property-name.desc: A CSS property name to set on the HTML element.

value.name: Value
value.desc: A string to assign as the value for this CSS property.

selector.name: Selector
selector.desc: A CSS selector which will be used to match elements. Leave empty to use the main HTML element.

type.name: Type
type.desc: Whether to affect one element matching the selector, or all matching elements.

actions.description: Set an object's size and position to match an HTML element.

object.name: Object
object.desc: The object to move and resize.

selector.name: Selector
selector.desc: A CSS selector identifying the element to position the object to.

actions.display-text: Create {0} image element at [i]{1}[/i], insert [i]{2}[/i], ID [i]{3}[/i], class [i]{4}[/i]
actions.description: Create an element with the image of a Sprite object and insert it.

object.name: Object
object.desc: The object to use an image from.

selector.name: Selector
selector.desc: A CSS selector identifying the parent element the image element will be inserted to. Leave empty to use the main HTML element.

insert.name: Insert
insert.desc: Whether to insert the image element at the start, end, or replace the entire content of the parent element.

id.name: ID
id.desc: An optional ID to set for the created image element.

class.name: Class
class.desc: An optional class to set for the created image element.

actions.description: Set the scroll position of a scrollable element.

selector.name: Selector
selector.desc: A CSS selector identifying the element to scroll. Leave empty to use the main HTML element.

direction.name: Direction
direction.desc: Whether to set the scroll left or top position.

position.name: Position
position.desc: The scroll position to set in CSS pixels.

expressions.description: String with HTML content of the element.
String with plain text content of the element.
In a trigger, the ID of the targeted element.
In a trigger, the class of the targeted element.
Convert HTML tag characters like < to entities like < so text cannot alter HTML.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: The tag name of the HTML element.

content.name: Content
content.desc: The initial content of the element.

content-type.name: Content type
content-type.desc: How to interpret the content string.

initially-visible.name: Initially visible
initially-visible.desc: Choose if the element is visible when the layout starts.

id.name: ID
id.desc: An optional ID for the element allowing it to be styled with CSS.

class.name: Class
class.desc: An optional class for the element allowing it to be styled with CSS.

allow-context-menu.name: Allow context menu
allow-context-menu.desc: Whether to allow showing the browser default context menu for this element.

stop-input-events.name: Stop input events
stop-input-events.desc: Whether to stop input events on the element reaching the rest of the project.

origin.name: Origin
origin.desc: Choose the location of the origin in the object.

set-color.name: Set color
set-color.desc: Whether to set the CSS color style for the element.

default-color.name: Default color
default-color.desc: The initial CSS color style to set.

set-background-color.name: Set background color
set-background-color.desc: Whether to set the CSS background-color style for the element.

default-background-color.name: Default background color
default-background-color.desc: The initial CSS background-color style to set.

auto-font-size.name: Auto font size
auto-font-size.desc: Automatically set the font size depending on the layer scale.

allow-text-selection.name: Allow text selection
allow-text-selection.desc: Whether to allow the user to select text inside this element.

style-attribute.name: Style attribute
style-attribute.desc: Additional initial content of the style attribute for this element.
